--- Table 1: adventureworks.sales.salesreason ---
Domain: Sales
Description: Lookup table of customer purchase reasons.
Fields:
  - name (character varying(50)): Descriptive name of the sales reason (e.g., 'Price', 'Quality', 'Promotion', 'Recommendation')
  - reasontype (character varying(50)): Category classification of the sales reason (e.g., 'Marketing', 'Product', 'Service', 'Competitive')
  - salesreasonid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for each sales reason record, serving as the primary key
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the sales reason record was last updated
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 2: adventureworks.sales.salesorderheader ---
Domain: SalesOrder
Description: General sales order information.
Fields:
  - accountnumber (character varying(15)): External customer account identifier used for billing and financial reconciliation
  - orderdate (timestamp without time zone): Calendar date when the customer placed or the system recorded the sales order
  - customerid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the customer entity who initiated and is responsible for the order
  - subtotal (numeric): Aggregate monetary value of all line items before applying taxes and freight charges
  - totaldue (numeric): Final amount payable by the customer including subtotal, taxes, freight, and any additional charges
  - shipdate (timestamp without time zone): Date when goods left the warehouse or fulfillment center for delivery to the customer
  - salespersonid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Identifier of the sales representative who facilitated or is credited with the order
  - shiptoaddressid (integer(32,0)): Reference to the physical destination address where ordered goods will be delivered
  - billtoaddressid (integer(32,0)): Reference to the address where the invoice will be sent and payment is expected
  - rowguid (uuid): Unique identifier for database replication and synchronization purposes across systems
  - shipmethodid (integer(32,0)): Carrier or shipping service level selected for delivering the order (e.g., ground, express, overnight)
  - purchaseordernumber (character varying(25)): Optional customer-provided purchase order reference number for B2B transactions
  - status (smallint(16,0)): Numeric code indicating the current stage in the order lifecycle such as pending, processing, shipped, or cancelled
  - comment (character varying(128)): Free-form text field for special instructions, customer requests, or internal notes about the order
  - creditcardid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to stored payment card information used for transaction processing
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.person.person ---
Domain: Person
Description: Human beings involved with AdventureWorks: employees, customer contacts, and vendor contacts.
Fields:
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Unique sequential identifier serving as the primary key for each person record in the system
  - additionalcontactinfo (xml): XML field storing miscellaneous contact information such as phone numbers and addresses beyond the primary contact methods
  - firstname (character varying(50)): Person's given or first name used in business communications and identification
  - namestyle (boolean): Boolean flag indicating whether the name follows Eastern name format (1) with family name first or Western format (0) with given name first
  - persontype (character(2)): Two-character code identifying the person's role: IN for individual customer, EM for employee, SP for sales person, VC for vendor contact, SC for store contact
  - suffix (character varying(10)): Optional name suffix such as Jr., Sr., PhD, or III used in formal name representation
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier assigned to each record for use in database replication and synchronization scenarios
  - lastname (character varying(50)): Person's family or surname used in business communications and identification
  - emailpromotion (integer(32,0)): Integer indicating the level of email marketing consent: 0 for no promotional emails, 1 for AdventureWorks catalog promotions, 2 for partner company promotions
  - middlename (character varying(50)): Person's middle name or initial used in formal identification
  - title (character varying(8)): Optional honorific prefix such as Mr., Ms., Mrs., or Dr. used in formal communications
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording the most recent date and time when any field in this person record was modified
  - demographics (xml): XML field containing customer demographic information including age range, occupation, number of children, and income level for marketing analysis

--- Table 5: adventureworks.sales.salesperson ---
Domain: Sales
Description: Sales representative current information.
Fields:
  - saleslastyear (numeric): Total sales amount the salesperson achieved during the previous fiscal year
  - salesytd (numeric): Total sales amount the salesperson has achieved year-to-date in the current fiscal year
  - rowguid (uuid): Globally unique identifier used for database replication and synchronization across systems
  - territoryid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the geographic sales territory assigned to and managed by the salesperson
  - commissionpct (numeric): Commission rate percentage that the salesperson earns on each sale
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the salesperson record was last updated or modified
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key reference to the underlying business entity (person) in the employee system
  - bonus (numeric): Monetary incentive awarded to the salesperson based on meeting or exceeding sales targets
  - salesquota (numeric): Target sales amount that the salesperson is expected to achieve within a defined period

  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp indicating when the currency record was last modified or updated in the system

Domain: Finance
Description: Currency exchange rates.
Fields:
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp showing when the exchange rate record was last modified or updated

  - endofdayrate (numeric): The official closing exchange rate at the end of the business day

  - stateprovinceid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Foreign key reference to the state or province entity defining the administrative region
